A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PolySHAP work. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices are readable and support reliable matching across the formatting changes.

before.justification: V1 reports original Shapley-estimator evaluations across 15 explanation games and 30 instances, including interaction-order comparisons, sampling comparisons, and runtime measurements.

after.justification: V3 retains these original empirical evaluations and adds numerical MSE summary tables in Appendix B.6.

M1.justification: The constrained polynomial regression, interaction frontiers, sampling strategies, and Shapley-value conversion remain unchanged. Algorithm 1 explicitly adds the outer projection already present in v1 Equation (7), aligning the pseudocode with the existing method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 15 tabular, image, language, and synthetic explanation games listed in Table 2. The additional tables summarize retained coverage.

E2.justification: The original comparisons retain Permutation Sampling, KernelSHAP, RegressionMSR, SVARM, MSR, and Unbiased KernelSHAP. Tables 4–5 summarize existing comparators already discussed in Sections 6 and B.2; the original full-baseline plots remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Appendix B.1 changes the stated regression scoring metric from F1-score to R². The 80/20 split, forest configuration, explanation metrics, and sampling procedures remain unchanged. This corrects a reported setting without establishing that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The interaction-order and partial-frontier comparisons, standard-versus-paired sampling analyses, ranking-metric analyses, and runtime study are retained. The new tables summarize existing comparisons without introducing another ablation or robustness question.

E5.justification: V3 adds first, second, and third quartiles of MSE in Tables 4–5, supplementing the existing mean-and-SEM plots. The 30-instance design remains unchanged, and no increased repetition count or new seed information is reported.

E6.justification: Tables 4–5 add numerical summaries, including previously unreported quartiles. For example, Table 4 reports paired 3-PolySHAP on Bike at m=1140 with mean MSE 8.0×10^-4 and median 1.8×10^-4. The existing result figures retain identical plotted content.

T1.justification: Theorem 4.4 gains the missing (1+epsilon) approximation factor. Appendix A corrects projection dimensions and several mathematical expressions, including the Möbius representation and its zero-coefficient condition. The principal theorems and proof strategies remain; the new table captions introduce an incorrect O(k) expression inconsistent with the retained parameter count.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims: consistent polynomial-based Shapley estimation, empirical approximation benefits, and equivalence between paired KernelSHAP and paired second-order PolySHAP.

C2.justification: The new table captions explicitly attribute RegressionMSR difficulties on Crime, alongside CG60, to the tree surrogate struggling to approximate the game; v1 explicitly identified CG60. Existing interpretations concerning dimensionality, evaluation budgets, ranking accuracy, and runtime remain.

D1.justification: Section 6 replaces the supplementary-material code statement with an explicit repository URL, also added to the expanded reproducibility statement. Hardware, software backbones, model configurations, and dataset-source information are otherwise retained.

R1.justification: V3 removes the TreeSHAP exception and associated Lundberg et al. (2018) citation from Section 3 and the bibliography. Research positioning otherwise remains stable. Updated publication information for ProxySPEX and RegressionMSR does not introduce new related works.

P1.justification: V3 corrects grammar, terminology, and cross-references, adds a short Section 4 introduction, rewrites the reproducibility statement, and adds acknowledgments and Appendix B.6. The overall narrative and section organization remain largely intact.

P2.justification: V3 adopts ICLR headers and a narrower text area, resizes and repositions existing displays, and adds two color-highlighted summary tables. All 14 existing figures retain their graphical content and organization. The new tables are densely typeset and have incomplete budget labels.

improvement.justification: Correcting Theorem 4.4 and appendix formulas, fixing the reported regression metric, and providing direct code-access information improve accuracy and usability. Added quartiles improve reporting, although incomplete budget labels, cramped tables, and erroneous O(k) captions limit the benefit. The central contributions and empirical evidence remain stable.
